input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer at any time without notice and may remotely access Customer's systems and records for that purpose.
input.rationale: Section 22.1 permits unlimited, unannounced audits with remote access to our systems, which is walk-away territory and fails even the fallback (no frequency cap, no notice period). Sections 22.2 and 22.3 are already protective: Vendor bears audit costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly, so only the frequency, notice, business-hours, off-site and independent-confidential-auditor limbs are missing. We conform 22.1 to the preferred position in one surgical replacement and delete the remote-access permission, which also removes its conflict with 22.2.

mappings.element: Vendor may audit no more than once in any 12-month period.
Vendor must give at least 30 days' written notice of an audit.
Audits are conducted by an independent auditor.
The auditor is bound by confidentiality obligations.
Audits are conducted off-site where possible.
Vendor bears audit costs unless underpayment exceeds 5 percent.
mappings.quote: Vendor bears audit costs unless the audit establishes an underpayment exceeding five percent for the audited period

mappings.element: Vendor has no direct access to Customer systems for an audit.
mappings.quote: Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly

proposal.summary: Conform Vendor's audit right to once-per-12-months, 30 days' written notice, business hours, off-site, independent confidential auditor; remove unannounced remote access.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We conform Section 22.1 to the audit protections already in Section 22.2: one audit per 12 months, 30 days' written notice, during business hours, off-site where possible, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, and we delete Vendor's unannounced remote access to our systems.

ops.oldText: Vendor may audit Customer at any time without notice and may remotely access Customer's systems and records for that purpose.
ops.newText: Vendor may audit Customer no more than once every 12 months, on 30 days' written notice, during business hours, off-site where possible, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality obligations.
